strategies.name: Buy and hold
strategies.summary: Always long: the benchmark every other strategy has to beat.

strategies.name: SMA crossover
strategies.summary: Long while the fast simple moving average is above the slow one.

strategies.name: EMA crossover
strategies.summary: Long while the fast exponential moving average is above the slow one.

strategies.name: MACD
strategies.summary: Long while the MACD line is above its signal line.

strategies.name: Time-series momentum
strategies.summary: Long while the price is above where it was a lookback ago.

strategies.name: Donchian breakout
strategies.summary: Buy a close above the highest high of the entry window; sell one below the lowest low of the exit window, as the Turtles did.

strategies.name: RSI reversion
strategies.summary: Buy when the RSI is oversold and sell when it is overbought.

strategies.name: Bollinger reversion
strategies.summary: Buy a close below the lower band and sell when the price is back above the middle.

strategies.name: RSI(2) pullback
strategies.summary: Buy sharp dips in an uptrend: a close above its long SMA with RSI(2) below the dip level, sold once the close is back above a short SMA (after Connors).

strategies.name: Custom rules
strategies.summary: Your own rules in the strategy language.

functions.name: sma
functions.description: Simple moving average of the last period bars

functions.name: ema
functions.description: Exponential moving average, weighting recent bars more, seeded with an SMA

functions.name: rsi
functions.description: Relative strength index with Wilder's smoothing, from 0 to 100

functions.name: stdev
functions.description: Standard deviation of the last period bars

functions.name: highest
functions.description: Highest value of the last period bars, this one included

functions.name: lowest
functions.description: Lowest value of the last period bars, this one included

functions.name: roc
functions.description: Rate of change over period bars: 0.05 is a 5% rise

functions.name: change
functions.description: Difference from period bars ago

functions.name: zscore
functions.description: Distance from the period-bar mean, in standard deviations

functions.name: atr
functions.description: Average true range, with Wilder's smoothing

functions.name: macd
functions.description: MACD line: the fast EMA minus the slow EMA

functions.name: macd_signal
functions.description: Signal line: an EMA of the MACD line

functions.name: bb_upper
functions.description: Upper Bollinger band: the SMA plus k standard deviations

functions.name: bb_lower
functions.description: Lower Bollinger band: the SMA minus k standard deviations

functions.name: crossover
functions.description: a rises above b on this bar: a > b now and a <= b on the bar before

functions.name: crossunder
functions.description: a falls below b on this bar: a < b now and a >= b on the bar before

functions.name: abs
functions.description: Absolute value

functions.name: min
functions.description: The smaller of a and b

functions.name: max
functions.description: The larger of a and b

functions.name: log
functions.description: Natural logarithm
